summary: Paaster is a self-hosted pastebin service designed for sharing text securely. It uses end-to-end encryption to ensure that the content remains private while keeping the user interface straightforward.
goodFor: Users who want a private, encrypted alternative to public text-sharing websites and prefer a minimalist approach.
watchOut: The project is relatively niche with a modest community footprint, meaning you may need to rely on the source code rather than extensive documentation for troubleshooting.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and ensure any necessary data persistence volumes are mapped correctly.
